lede: Vancouver had last change, so Manny Malhotra picked most of these matchups. Vancouver played without Marco Rossi. Carolina played without Mike Reilly and Mark Jankowski.

notes.head: The fourth line drew Kotkaniemi’s line
notes.text: Manny Malhotra sent Bains, Sasson and Gallagher out for 6:53 of their 8:35 at 5-on-5 against Nadeau, Kotkaniemi and Deslauriers (80%, about 24% with no line matching), and they had the better of the chances, 0.50 to 0.34 expected goals. Carolina scored two of its six goals then.

notes.head: E. Pettersson’s line drew Aho’s line
notes.text: DeBrusk, E. Pettersson and Karlsson spent 7:20 of their 9:26 at 5-on-5 against Carrier, Aho and Svechnikov (78%, about 27% with no line matching), and they had the worse of the chances, 0.26 to 0.60 expected goals. Vancouver scored one of its three goals then.

notes.head: Boeser’s line drew Ehlers’s line
notes.text: Cotter, Chytil and Boeser spent 10:04 of their 13:48 at 5-on-5 against Ehlers, Stankoven and Blake (73%, about 26% with no line matching), and they had the worse of the chances, 0.04 to 0.93 expected goals. Carolina scored one of its six goals then.

foot: Manny Malhotra matched harder than in his other home games: each line spent 70% of its time against one opposing line, against 43% to 56% in his first three.
